name: Identity Fusion NG
description: Identity Fusion NG is a connector that allows you to manage Identity Fusion accounts by mapping account attributes from multiple sources, defining new attributes and unique identifiers, and matching accounts with existing identities to prevent duplicates.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Configure how this connector connects to Identity Security Cloud.

Use Identity Security Cloud API URL to specify the base URL of your ISC tenant (for example, https://tenant.api.identitynow.com).

Provide the Personal Access Token ID and Personal Access Token Secret for an account that has the required API permissions (Sources, Identities, Accounts, Workflows/Forms). These values authenticate all connector operations.

See also: Tune API performance guide · ISC PAT scopes reference.

items.label: Identity Security Cloud API URL
items.helpKey: Tenant API base URL for Identity Security Cloud.

items.label: Personal Access Token ID
items.helpKey: Enter the Client ID from your Personal Access Token.

items.label: Personal Access Token secret
items.helpKey: Enter the Client Secret from your Personal Access Token.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Define which identities are in scope.

Limit processing using an Identity Scope Query (standard ISC search syntax). Toggle Include identities in the scope to establish a baseline population for Match alongside managed source accounts.

See also: Configuring sources and scope.

items.label: Include identities in the scope?
items.helpKey: When enabled, existing identities are included alongside accounts from your configured sources.

items.label: Identity Scope Query
items.helpKey: Filter which identities are included using a search query.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Select and configure authoritative account sources.

Source type and behavior: Define role (Authoritative, Records, Orphan) and handling for non-matched non-identity accounts (disable, defer).

Aggregation and correlation: Control timing (delays, retries), optimized aggregation, and correlation strategy (in-process or reverse).

Filtering and limits: Process subsets via API/JMESPath filters and set batch capacities.

See also: Configuring sources and scope · Source types guide.

items.label: Source name
items.helpKey: Enter the exact name of the source as it appears in Identity Security Cloud (case-sensitive).

items.label: Enabled
items.helpKey: Turn off to temporarily exclude this source from processing without removing it.

items.label: Source type
items.helpKey: Choose how accounts from this source are handled.

items.label: Orphan processing mode
items.helpKey: Assignment correlates uncorrelated accounts; Ownership assigns an owner identity to unowned machine accounts.

items.label: Disable non-matching accounts
items.helpKey: Automatically disable orphan accounts that no longer match any identity after aggregation.

items.label: Deferred candidate matching
items.helpKey: Deferred candidate matching: after identity scoring, also compare this account to other provisional Fusion accounts from.

items.label: Include record accounts in Match
items.helpKey: Enable when record accounts should be matched against Fusion identities.

items.label: Accounts API filter
items.helpKey: Server-side ISC account filter sent to the Accounts API (filters parameter).

items.label: Accounts JMESPath filter
items.helpKey: Client-side JMESPath filter applied to fetched account pages.

items.label: Aggregation batch size
items.helpKey: Onboarding only: cap the managed accounts processed per run for a large, static set. Not for regular operation — the cumulative limit assumes accounts are not added or removed between runs.

items.label: Account aggregation mode
items.helpKey: Choose when to pull the latest accounts from this source.

items.label: Aggregation wait timeout (minutes)
items.helpKey: Maximum time to wait for this source's aggregation to finish when using Aggregate before processing.

items.label: Aggregation delay (minutes)
items.helpKey: How many minutes to wait after processing completes before refreshing accounts from this source.

items.label: Optimized aggregation
items.helpKey: Only process accounts that have changed since the last run, improving performance.

items.label: Optimized aggregation
items.helpKey: Only process accounts that have changed since the last run, improving performance.

items.label: Correlation mode
items.helpKey: Choose how uncorrelated source accounts are linked to identities.

items.label: Correlation attribute display name
items.helpKey: Friendly display label for the reverse-correlation attribute shown in Identity Security Cloud.

items.label: Correlation attribute name
items.helpKey: Internal name for the attribute used to link accounts via reverse correlation.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Control account maintenance.

History limits: Cap the number of audit history messages stored per account.

Delete when empty: Remove the Fusion account if all its underlying source accounts are deleted.

Skip missing targets: Ignore source accounts missing a mapped native identity attribute.

Promote first found managed account: When enabled, set mainAccount to the first live managed account while the origin is not a current contributor, and clear mainAccount when the origin is a current contributor again.

See also: Configuring sources and scope.

items.label: Maximum history messages
items.helpKey: Number of processing history entries to keep per account.

items.label: Delete accounts with no managed accounts left?
items.helpKey: Automatically remove a Fusion account when all of its linked source accounts have been deleted. Record source accounts do not count.

items.label: Skip accounts with missing ID?
items.helpKey: Skip accounts that are missing a unique identity value.

items.label: Promote first found managed account to main account when origin account is missing
items.helpKey: While enabled, set mainAccount to the first live managed account while the origin is not a current contributor, and clear mainAccount when the origin is a current contributor again.

items.label: Enable cascade aggregation for single account read
items.helpKey: Aggregate managed sources before single account read.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Map and merge source attributes.

Choose a Default attribute merge mode. Then configure per-attribute rules to target specific source fields, rename them on the Fusion account, and optionally override the merge strategy or pin specific sources.

See also: Mapping attributes guide.

items.label: Default attribute merge from multiple sources
items.helpKey: When multiple sources provide the same attribute, choose how to combine them.

items.label: New attribute
items.helpKey: Name for this attribute on the Fusion account.

items.label: Existing attributes
items.helpKey: Names to pull values from, tried in order. Explicit maps run in list order, so a later map can read an earlier new attribute, that prior mapped value wins over the same snapshot name, and a selective map does not use maps it did not request.

items.label: Default attribute merge from multiple sources
items.helpKey: Override the default merge strategy for this specific attribute.

items.label: Source name
items.helpKey: Name of the source whose value should be used for this attribute when available.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Define dynamic computed attributes. Apache Velocity; optional Always recalculate. Post-template options: case, character normalization, spaces, trim, max length.

Definitions run top to bottom — each result is available to the next. See the Velocity context reference for $accounts, $identity, $previous, and helper functions.

See also: Defining attributes guide · Velocity context reference.

items.label: Normal Attribute Definitions
items.helpKey: Define attributes whose values are defined from templates using mapped account data.

items.label: Attribute Name
items.helpKey: Name for this defined attribute on the Fusion account.

items.label: Apache Velocity expression
items.helpKey: Velocity template that defines the attribute value.

items.label: Static
items.helpKey: When enabled, the attribute is evaluated only when it has no value.

items.label: Always recalculate?
items.helpKey: When enabled, the expression runs every aggregation even if managed source data is unchanged. When disabled, existing values are kept unless source data changed, the account is reset, or force attribute refresh is on.

items.label: Case selection
items.helpKey: Convert the defined value to a specific letter case.

items.label: Normalize special characters?
items.helpKey: Replace accented characters with plain ASCII equivalents.

items.label: Remove spaces?
items.helpKey: Remove all spaces from the defined value.

items.label: Trim leading and trailing spaces?
items.helpKey: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from the defined value, including spaces, tabs, newlines, and carriage returns.

items.label: Maximum length
items.helpKey: Limit the defined value to this many characters.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Define persistent unique attributes (e.g. identifiers). Values stay until account reset (disable/re-enable). Runs after normal definitions on refresh.

Supports $counter, $UUID, and $isUnique(). Use incremental counter mode for sequential IDs; otherwise the connector uses collision-based disambiguation with padding per Minimum counter digits.

See also: Defining attributes guide · Velocity context reference.

items.label: Maximum attempts for unique definition
items.helpKey: Maximum number of tries to find a value that is not already taken.

items.label: Unique Attribute Definitions
items.helpKey: Define attributes that must have a unique value across all accounts, such as usernames or employee IDs.

items.label: Attribute Name
items.helpKey: Name for this unique attribute on the Fusion account.

items.label: Apache Velocity expression
items.helpKey: Velocity template that defines the unique value (required).

items.label: Minimum counter digits ($counter)
items.helpKey: Minimum number of digits for the counter, padded with leading zeros.

items.label: Use incremental counter?
items.helpKey: Always assign the next number in sequence instead of only adding a number when there is a conflict.

items.label: Counter start value
items.helpKey: The first number the counter will use.

items.label: Case selection
items.helpKey: Convert the defined value to a specific letter case.

items.label: Normalize special characters?
items.helpKey: Replace accented characters with plain ASCII equivalents.

items.label: Remove spaces?
items.helpKey: Remove all spaces from the defined value.

items.label: Trim leading and trailing spaces?
items.helpKey: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from the defined value, including spaces, tabs, newlines, and carriage returns.

items.label: Maximum length
items.helpKey: Limit the defined value to this many characters.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Configure similarity-based match detection.

Evaluate matches using Fusion attribute matches to calculate a Combined match score.

Algorithms: Text, phonetic, and intelligent gap comparisons.

Thresholds and weights: Set minimum scores for individual rules and the overall match. Pass thresholds double as blend weights.

Automatic merge: Optionally bypass manual review when the combined score meets your automatic merge threshold.

See also: Matching identities guide · Tuning matching algorithms.

items.label: Enable manual review
items.helpKey: When enabled, potential matches below the automatic merge threshold may enter manual review when reviewers are configured.

items.label: Manual review match score [0-100]
items.helpKey: Minimum weighted combined similarity (0-100) required for a potential match.

items.label: Enable automatic merge
items.helpKey: When enabled, merge the managed account into the matched Fusion identity without a review form if the combined score mee.

items.label: Automatic merge match score [0-100]
items.helpKey: Matches with a combined score equal to or higher than this threshold will be automatically merged.

items.label: Attribute
items.helpKey: Account attribute to compare when looking for matches.

items.label: Matching algorithm
items.helpKey: Algorithm used to compare values.

options.label: Enhanced Name Matcher
options.docLinkLabel: Strict matching that handles accents and normalization

options.label: Jaro-Winkler
options.docLinkLabel: Mechanical string comparison tolerant of typos

options.label: LIG3
options.docLinkLabel: Advanced hybrid handling missing gaps and character variations

options.label: Dice
options.docLinkLabel: N-gram model highly tolerant of word reordering

options.label: Double Metaphone
options.docLinkLabel: Evaluates strings based on their English pronunciation

items.label: Custom match score (Velocity)
items.helpKey: Apache Velocity template evaluated for each account/identity pair.

items.label: Similarity threshold & weight [0-100]
items.helpKey: Minimum similarity and blend weight for this rule (0-100).

items.label: Mandatory match
items.helpKey: When enabled, this rule must meet its minimum similarity for a potential match.

items.label: Skip match if missing
items.helpKey: When enabled (default), this rule is skipped if either value is missing (null, undefined, or empty after trimming).

items.label: Skip match if threshold not met
items.helpKey: When enabled, this rule is excluded from the weighted combined match score if its computed similarity is below its minimum.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Configure manual review for potential matches.

Define Form attributes to display to reviewers and set candidate limits. Assign global reviewers to act as fail-safes and optionally email them processing reports after each aggregation.

See also: Review forms and reviewers.

items.label: List of Fusion account attributes to include in form
items.helpKey: Account attributes displayed on the review form to help reviewers compare potential matches.

items.label: Maximum candidates per review form
items.helpKey: Maximum number of potential identity matches shown on each manual review form.

items.label: Manual review expiration days
items.helpKey: Number of days a reviewer has to respond before the review form expires.

items.label: Owners are global reviewers?
items.helpKey: Always add the source owner and any member of the source's assigned governance group as reviewers on every review form,.

items.label: Send report to owner on aggregation?
items.helpKey: Send a summary report to the source owner after each run, including potential matches, processing outcomes, and source-t.

items.label: Enable localized user communications?
items.helpKey: Localize emails, aggregation reports, and Fusion review forms.

items.label: Default Language
items.helpKey: Fallback language when a reviewer has no language attribute. English is the default.

items.label: Identity Language Attribute
items.helpKey: Identity attribute containing the reviewer's preferred language.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Advanced options for troubleshooting and performance tuning.

Use these settings to safely recover from configuration changes (e.g. rebuilding accounts or forcing attribute recalculation) and manage memory consumption during match detection by adjusting batch sizes.

Installed connector version: 2.2.0.

See also: Operation guides.

items.label: Reset accounts?
items.helpKey: On the next aggregation only, clear all Fusion account data and emit zero accounts (rebuild from scratch on the followin.

items.label: Reset forms?
items.helpKey: On the next aggregation only, close in-flight Fusion reviews: delete matching Fusion review form definitions and cancel leftover open instances.

items.label: Force attribute refresh on next aggregation?
items.helpKey: On the next aggregation only, recalculate all computed Normal-type attributes even if no changes were detected.

items.label: Enable concurrency check?
items.helpKey: Safeguard against data conflicts if multiple aggregations overlap.

items.label: Skip Fusion accounts with duplicate names?
items.helpKey: Keep the first Fusion account for an identity and skip later accounts with duplicate names.

items.label: Managed accounts batch size
items.helpKey: Number of uncorrelated managed accounts processed in each match detection batch.

items.label: Scoring concurrency limit
items.helpKey: Maximum concurrent identity-comparison scoring operations during managed-account analysis.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Configure external infrastructure for proxy processing, logging, and recording.

Enable external processing to reveal a shared target URL and password, then choose sub-options for proxy mode, scenario recording, and external logging. When proxy mode is off, external logging sends HTTP POST to the target URL from ISC. When proxy mode is on, the proxy server writes logs to disk.

See also: Proxy mode reference · Scenario recording reference.

items.label: Enable external processing?
items.helpKey: Gateway toggle for external infrastructure.

items.label: Server URL
items.helpKey: Shared external target — proxy endpoint when proxy mode is on, log HTTP endpoint when proxy mode is off.

items.label: Enable proxy mode?
items.helpKey: Delegate operation processing to the external target.

items.label: Password
items.helpKey: Required when proxy mode is on. Must match PROXY_PASSWORD on the proxy server host.

items.label: Enable chain recording?
items.helpKey: Record API call chains on the proxy server for replay testing.

items.label: Recording chain name
items.helpKey: Name for the recording chain directory.

items.label: Enable external logging?
items.helpKey: Stream connector logs to external infrastructure.

items.label: External logging level
items.helpKey: Minimum log level for external logging delivery.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Fine-tune API limits and execution resilience.

Adjust these parameters to prevent the connector from being rate-limited by Identity Security Cloud, ensure long-running operations complete without timing out, and optimize throughput by adjusting request concurrency and batching sizes.

See also: Tune API performance guide.

items.label: Provisioning timeout (seconds)
items.helpKey: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a provisioning operation to complete.

items.label: Maximum concurrent requests
items.helpKey: How many HTTP requests can run at the same time.

items.label: Parallel pagination batch size
items.helpKey: Max in-flight parallel pages per pagination stream.

items.label: Requests per second
items.helpKey: Legacy rate hint: derives the sliding-window cap as requests per second × 10 seconds (max 100).

items.label: API request retries
items.helpKey: How many times to retry a failed request before giving up.

items.label: Processing wait time (seconds)
items.helpKey: How often (in seconds) to send a progress signal during long operations to prevent timeouts. Must not exceed 180.

items.label: Heartbeat interval (seconds)
items.helpKey: How often (in seconds) the connector emits STATUS and EVENT_SUMMARY lines during long operations.

items.label: Enable priority processing?
items.helpKey: Process critical operations (like saving data) before less urgent ones (like logging).
